meta.title: Crowded day
meta.description: Seven items over the same two hours: the column cap, the promotion and the overflow chip.

scenario: Five items start at 09:00 and run to 10:30; two more overlap them; one sits alone in the afternoon. This is where a timeline has to decide what it cannot draw, and the decision is the same every time: three columns, strongest first, and the rest behind a chip.
look: Three columns at most, which is the default cap; in compact mode it drops to one.
The critical item starts half an hour after the five before it, so the columns are full by the time it arrives. It is promoted into one anyway, and the weakest item there gives up its place.
What does not fit collapses into a More chip. Opening it gives a table of those items, strongest first, paged when there are many.
The list view has no cap at all — it is the view to reach for when every item has to be visible at once.
